summary: Increment 4a of the world-engine history program: a deterministic, three-free volcanic / endogenic-heat relief writer (src/worldengine/base/magmatism.js, writeMagmatismSphere), sibling of plates.js and shellRelief.js, that REPLACES the sin^2(lat) fallback for volcanic bodies ONLY (Lava / Magma-K2-141b / Io-type). All structure keyed off ONE seeded mantle-plume field: hotspot/edifice (shield) placement at plume tops + effusive lava-plain flooding of the lows + a substellar magma-ocean BASIN (depression) for locked extreme-T bodies. Placement is seed-only (driver-response deferred, exactly as plates.js shipped). The volcanic gate is checked only AFTER isEarthlikePlatePath and isShellReliefPath return, so it never touches the validated plate path or the icy path. Venus stagnant-lid (#4b) is OUT (parallel research -> own scope).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: DETERMINISM + NO-RNG: magmatism.js contains no Math.random()/Date.now() call form and no convergence while-loop (render-once, bounded passes), and writeMagmatismSphere run twice on the same fresh carrier yields byte-identical fields for every seed x body-case; |U| < MAGMA_BOUND.

verifyVia.input: Static-grep magmatism.js for /Math\.random\s*\(|Date\.now\s*\(/ (zero matches) + render-once guard (no threshold while-loop); run writeMagmatismSphere(carrier,{},{macroSeed:s, locked:L}) twice for s in {1,2,3,7,42} x L in {false,true} on a fresh 600-node carrier.
verifyVia.observable: Zero RNG matches; byte-identical U, plumeId, hotspotProximity, lavaPlainMask, magmaOceanMask (typed-array equality) across the two runs for every (s,L); |U[i]| < MAGMA_BOUND for all nodes.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: STRUCTURE BAR (signal must PASS): U is explained by the seeded mantle-plume geometry (edifices sit at plume tops, not sprinkled), with a predictor rebuilt ARM'S-LENGTH from the published plume centers (NOT from the writer's own hotspotNode); and the elevation ordering mean(edifice/shield) > mean(lava-plain) > mean(magma-ocean basin) holds.

verifyVia.input: On the 600-node carrier, rebuild a signed plume/hotspot-proximity predictor via BFS geodesic falloff from the published plume centers; measure corr(U, predictor); compute mean U over edifice nodes vs lava-plain nodes vs magma-ocean-basin nodes; compare edifice amplitude to the quiet-plain denominator.
verifyVia.observable: |corr(U, plume-proximity predictor)| >= 0.5; mean(edifice) > mean(lava-plain) > mean(magmaOcean basin); edifice(shield-crest) amplitude >= 2x the quiet-plain denominator. [Exact thresholds finalized against the plume-field mechanism in mustFix #1.]

acceptanceCriteria.statement: LATITUDE CONTROL (must FAIL): U is NOT explained by carrier +y latitude bands - the load-bearing falsifier vs the sin^2(lat) fallback this writer replaces.

verifyVia.input: Correlate U vs sin^2(carrier +y latitude), for both locked and unlocked volcanic cases.
verifyVia.observable: varExplainedByLatitudeY < 0.15 AND strictly < varExplainedByPlume, for every case.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: RANDOM-PLACEMENT CONTROL (must FAIL): a control variant with hotspot/edifice placement DECOUPLED from the plume field (isotropic/random node picks, amplitude-matched) collapses the structure signal - proving the plume field, not merely 'some bumps', carries the organization.

verifyVia.input: Build a control variant of the writer with plume-steered placement replaced by random placement; measure corr(U_control, plume-proximity) and the elevation ordering.
verifyVia.observable: Control corr(U_control, plume-proximity) collapses toward 0 AND the mean(edifice)>mean(plain)>mean(basin) ordering breaks; the real field PASSES AC2.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: NOISE CONTROL (must FAIL): the real plume-organized field beats amplitude-matched pure noise.

verifyVia.input: Correlate U vs an independent amplitude-matched simplex field.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: VARIETY: two different macroSeeds produce different volcanic worlds, each reproducible per seed.

verifyVia.input: Build the field with two different macroSeeds, same body-case.
verifyVia.observable: Different plumeCount OR < 0.2 node-overlap of hotspotNode, AND a visibly different plume layout; each seed reproducible.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: NO-CLOBBER of the Earth-like plate path: terrestrial/ocean unlocked bodies still route to the plate writer, byte-identical to a pre-change baseline.

verifyVia.input: Call writeBodyRelief with archetype in {terrestrial, ocean}, locked=false.
verifyVia.observable: Returns path:'plate' with magmaDiag:null; the plate U field is byte-identical to the captured pre-change baseline; the plate AC2 structure test still passes unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: NO-CLOBBER of the shell + despun paths and dispatch safety: icy/despun bodies keep their byte-identical paths, and a non-volcanic body (Earth-like / icy / gas) does NOT match the volcanic writer; the volcanic gate is checked only AFTER plate and shell return.

verifyVia.input: Call writeBodyRelief with Europa (shell), impact-airless unlocked (despun), and gas-giant; assert isVolcanicPath false for each; confirm gate order plate -> shell -> volcanic -> despun in writeBodyRelief.
verifyVia.observable: shell/despun paths byte-identical to baseline (magmaDiag:null off the volcanic path); isVolcanicPath returns false for terrestrial/ocean/icy/gas-giant/sub-neptune/carbon/crystal archetypes; only the volcanic set matches.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: SEAM FIRES + T_ss-SCALED BASIN: the Lava and Magma (K2-141b) presets route to the volcanic regime, and the substellar magma-ocean basin EXTENT scales with substellar temperature T_ss via the shipped F41 iso-angle law acos((1300/T_ss)^4) - a WIDE sea for Magma vs a SMALL pond for Lava. NOTE (SLICE-A finding): BOTH presets are locked:true, so the gate keys on T_ss / extreme-T, NOT locked-vs-unlocked.

verifyVia.input: With the lab PRESET routing, route 'Lava (hot airless)' (T_eq 950) and 'Magma (K2-141b)' (T_eq 2000); inspect the magmaOceanMask basin half-angle for each. T_ss = T_eq*1.4 (F41 convention: Lava~1330 K, Magma~2800 K); T_liquidus = 1300 K.
verifyVia.observable: Both route to path:'volcanic' (never silently to sin^2); magmaOceanMask is a single coherent substellar basin whose half-angle ~ acos((1300/T_ss)^4): Magma ~1.5 rad (wide sea), Lava ~0.4 rad (small pond), with Magma's basin strictly wider than Lava's.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: LIVE magmaProbe: in the running lab, the Lava and Magma presets bake onto the carrier and the probe proves the relief is plume-organized, not latitude - and the landforms look distinct.

verifyVia.input: In the lab on a fresh tab of the running Chrome (localhost:5173/well-dipper -> lab), select Lava (then Magma), window._lab.setSeed(1234); window._lab.reliefBakeStrength(1); force a route; window._lab.magmaProbe(); take a screenshot.
verifyVia.observable: heightSource=='carrier'; regime=='volcanic'; varExplainedByPlume > varExplainedByLatitudeY; the mean(edifice)>mean(plain)>mean(basin) ordering holds; screenshot shows shield edifices + dark lava plains (+ a substellar magma-ocean basin for Magma) vs sin^2 bands.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: UAT (Max-only): Lava / Magma / Io read as distinct, recognizable volcanic worlds and cohere as the experience Max wanted - not a latitude smear.

verifyVia.input: Max views Lava and Magma in the lab (against a recording per the Max recording protocol if motion matters).
verifyVia.observable: Max judges each as a genuinely distinct volcanic world (Io shields != flood-lava plains != magma sea); holistic acceptance. Never PASSed by any agent - deferred-to-max.

mustFix: #1 (mechanism, pin before SLICE B): the seeded mantle-plume field + the three relief contributions. Plume field = N plume centers seeded from macroSeed (like plate centroids) -> spherical-Voronoi/geodesic partition -> per-node plume-proximity. Edifice = shield/strato analytic profile at plume tops, THRESHOLD crest rule gated by plume proximity (NOT a relative local-max). Lava-plain flooding = fill nodes below a flood datum between edifices (effusive plains sit low). Substellar magma-ocean basin = a hemisphere-scale depression centered on the substellar axis, gated on locked & extreme-T. Give the analytic height functions + normalization into MAGMA_BOUND + the elevation-ordering guarantee mean(edifice)>mean(plain)>mean(basin). Cite Io hotspot/shield volcanism + flood-basalt/lava-plain morphology.

RETROFIT NOTE (single-source-of-truth): volcanic geology already exists as LEGACY-SYNTH SHADER features - F7 edificeCombiner (shield/strato cones, planet-lod-lab.html:378) and F41 substellar magma-sea (uMagmaSeaAngle/uMagmaTemp/uMagmaChurnSpeed, the K2-141b GCM law). These are DEFAULT-OFF for carrier assessment (commit cfbe42c). magmatism.js is the carrier-side source of the same geology (height/basin); do NOT wire the writer to the F7/F41 shader this increment (lab-only, carrier-assessment view). The F41 magma-sea is a surface-shading/temperature layer; the writer authors the BASIN geometry - complementary, not a rewrite of F41. (Same retrofit shape as #4.5's shipped shatterCombiner.)

Dispatch safety (SLICE-A BUILT + verified): isVolcanicPath (set {lava, volcanic}) checked AFTER isEarthlikePlatePath and isShellReliefPath return; strict-'>' Voronoi tie-break (lowest-index), matching plates/shell. SLICE-A findings: (a) 'lava' being in shellRelief's SHELL_EXCLUDE is the load-bearing reason a LOCKED lava/Magma body falls through the shell locked-fallback down to the volcanic gate. (b) The bare 'volcanic' tag is NOT in SHELL_EXCLUDE, so a hypothetical locked archetype='volcanic' body would be grabbed by shell's eyeball-despun fallback first - harmless today (no preset emits 'volcanic'; Lava/Magma use 'lava'), but if SLICE B routes a locked 'volcanic'-tagged body, add 'volcanic' to SHELL_EXCLUDE (shellRelief.js, currently out-of-scope). (c) LATENT-BUG FIX: Magma (K2-141b) had NO PRESET_ARCHETYPE entry -> archetype null + locked -> shell eyeball-despun MISROUTE (Magma was rendering as ICY); adding PRESET_ARCHETYPE['Magma (K2-141b)']='lava' corrects it (NAMED_BODY still forces canonical radius).
Copy the vec3 helpers + meanEdgeAngle VERBATIM into magmatism.js (plates.js/shellRelief.js/tectonic.js out-of-scope to edit).

Substellar magma-ocean basin (SLICE B): the gate + extent key on T_ss (= T_eq*1.4, F41 convention), NOT on locked - both Lava & Magma are locked:true (SLICE-A finding). Basin half-angle = acos((1300/T_ss)^4) reusing the shipped F41 magmaSeaAngle law (T_liquidus 1300 K): Magma ~1.52 rad wide sea, Lava ~0.42 rad small pond. Thread T_ss into writeMagmatismSphere. The substellar AXIS is seed-derived (no star-direction response this increment); the F41-alignment question (carrier basin axis vs the scene's real substellar point) is a deferred SLICE-B/UAT consideration - fine for lab carrier-assessment (F41 default-OFF).
Venus #4b stagnant-lid is explicitly OUT (parallel research pass -> its own scope right after). Mars is OUT (different stagnant-lid-rocky shape, needs its own research).
